ios.name: Habitly: Habit Tracker & Diary
ios.subtitle: Routine Planner & Reminders
ios.promotionalText: Check off today's habits in one tap, and every Sunday see which ones stuck and which slipped.
ios.description:
Habitly is a habit tracker that helps busy people build routines that last.

• Today: the day's habits as a checklist
• Streak calendar: every day you kept a habit
• Weekly review: which habits stuck and which slipped
• Reminders at the time you usually do the habit
• Widgets and a one-line mood note

Free with up to 5 habits; Habitly Plus unlocks unlimited habits and the full review history.

play.title: Habitly: Habit Tracker & Diary
play.shortDescription: Build daily routines that stick, with timely reminders and a weekly review.
play.fullDescription:
Habitly is a habit tracker that helps busy people build routines that last. Pick a few habits, check them off each day, and let the habit tracker show your streak for each one.

• Today: the day's habits as a checklist
• Streak calendar: every day you kept a habit
• Weekly review: which habits stuck and which slipped
• Reminders at the time you usually do the habit, learned from your check-ins
• Widgets: check off a habit from the home screen
• Mood note: one line about your day, next to your habits in the review

Use Habitly as a habit tracker and a short daily diary. Free with up to 5 habits; Habitly Plus unlocks unlimited habits and the full review history.
